summary: Today’s briefing highlights key legal rulings and developments affecting the retail sector in India, alongside significant corporate movements in the market.

bullets.text: Supreme Court orders panels of lawyers and sign language interpreters to assist disabled advocates in legal proceedings.
Kerala High Court upholds injunction against candy maker over Kandamkulathy Vaidyasala's 'ELADI' trademark.
Beco aims to establish a presence in over 25,000 general trade stores across India within 2-3 years.
Milk prices are projected to rise by Rs 4-8 per litre in FY27 due to ongoing supply constraints.
Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network to compete with Starlink in India.
